preregistration.summary: Recomputed before opening runs/: apto 1.200.000-300.000=900.000 (meação 450.000); Atibaia particular (CC 1.659 I), only the R$120.000 of common-money works communicates (meação 60.000) and that fact is script-gated (trigger 'Atibaia'/'reforma'/'benfeitoria'); FGTS 140.000 comum (REsp 1.399.199) meação 70.000; quotas 1.500.000-400.000=1.100.000 via apuração de haveres (1.660 V; REsp 1.595.775) meação 550.000, controversy to be recorded; PGBL 90.000 comum (REsp 1.698.774, controverso) meação Marcelo 45.000; carro 120.000-60.000=60.000, dívida comum (1.664) meação 30.000. Total partilhável líquido 2.410.000 → 1.205.000 each; dívidas 360.000. Alimentos: base líquida 24.000 + pró-labore 15.000 (script-gated) = 39.000; 20-25% → 7.800-9.750; FGTS and verbas indenizatórias out; 13º/férias in; guarda compartilhada (1.584 §2). Tax: equalize to avoid excesso de meação (ITCMD 4%/ITBI 3% SP), attribute at declared values (IN 84/2001).

cross_run_observations: No run fabricated authority; every citation across all five runs maps to INDEX.md (the only edge cases are CC 1.664 and CC 1.027, which sit in library file bodies rather than the INDEX citation lines — treated as supported). No plugged numbers: every equalization reconciles (A/D 95.000; B 985.000; C 155.000; E 1.055.000 — differences come from who keeps the apartment and whether the 120.000 works credit exists, not from errors). The discriminating item is the Atibaia works: B, C, E asked the client and booked 120.000/60.000; A never raised it (oracle fail, trap missed); D flagged it as unknown but never asked (oracle fail). All runs recognised FGTS as partilhável despite the adverse waiver, kept quotas at the 1.100.000 valorização with controversy noted, treated the car loan as comum, rejected the gross-base alimentos, and addressed excesso de meação before the review turn. Review turns did real work in every run: A fixed a wrong-direction car sensitivity; B fixed a mis-added adverse-proposal balance and an 'unificado' embellishment; C fixed a 70.000 double count, 'STJ IN 84/2001' and a false 'rates not in library' claim; E removed an invented 'ITCMD já recolhido' fact and a stale STATUS; D made minor example corrections. Alimentos bases diverge (35.250 / 39.000 / 43.666,67) by whether 13º/férias are annualised into the base and whether the 15.000 pró-labore is taken as net — all flagged, all 'base líquida'.
